videos.desc: On a beach at dusk a woman drags a stick through the sand all the way around to draw a huge circle. Friends line it with white shells, then the whole group stands along the ring holding shoulders, forming a human circle seen from above.
videos.said: All the way round. It's closed!

videos.desc: On a construction site, two young people run their hands along the corner of a concrete pillar, fit a triangular wooden board perfectly into the corner between two walls saying "perfect fit", then play peek-a-boo around the corner of tall concrete walls and surprise each other.
In a boatyard, a young man rolls blue paint along the white side of a big wooden boat; more workers join in with rollers until the whole side of the hull is painted bright blue from bow to stern.
Two bricklayers lay a row of bricks exactly along a stretched string line; the woman sights down the perfectly straight row, winks, then points down a road that runs dead straight to the horizon.

A car park by the sea. A bearded man in a flat cap and navy jacket pushes a bright red bubble car by hand out of a parking space; the little car is so low that it barely reaches his waist and it is dwarfed on both sides by two enormous black SUVs. He rolls it out, climbs in through the front and drives it along a coastal road, its three wheels and glass bubble roof tiny against the wide blue bay. He parks under a big spreading tree and sits on a bench beside it, with the city skyline across the water, then drives slowly away down the path.

A young man in a black t-shirt jumps up and down with his arms spread wide on the concrete of a launch site at sunset. Behind him, filling the whole frame, stands an enormous stainless-steel rocket lying on its transporter, so big that he only reaches the height of its lower fins. The shot cuts to a low angle looking straight up the shining rocket into the pink evening sky, then to the rocket standing tall in silhouette between two palm trees with the sun behind it. Back at the transporter he jumps again with both fists in the air.

In a garden a woman holds a clear plastic strip in both hands and pulls the ends down so that it curves into an arch in front of her face, pulling a delighted expression. She does the same with a thick tree branch, hauling it down into a curve over her head. Then on the grass a girl in a leotard drops backwards into a full crab position with her whole body arched, while the woman crouches beside her with her mouth open.

In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.

A man in a cream sweater opens a tall fridge-freezer in a bright white kitchen and looks at completely bare shelves. The camera drops to an empty freezer drawer holding only one ice-cube tray. Then hands start loading the shelves: bags of frozen vegetables and berries, tubs, boxes and packets, until every shelf and drawer is packed. The last shot is a wide of the double doors open on a fridge stuffed from top to bottom while the man beams at it.

At an outdoor restaurant on an Italian street a young waiter in a white shirt and dark apron stands over a checked tablecloth and grates a large block of hard cheese onto a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce. He keeps going, grinning, as the diner beside him leans in laughing and the cheese buries the pasta. The camera holds on the plate as the shavings pile higher and higher until the food has disappeared under a huge white cone of grated cheese that rises above the wine glasses. In the last shot he holds up the cheese block and grater beside the mountain of cheese and smiles at the camera.

A woman in a conical straw hat and a green apron waters a tray of tiny seedlings in a greenhouse, then waters tomato plants hung with red tomatoes, then stands beside a sunflower far taller than she is and looks up at its big yellow head.

A man in a bright orange sleeveless sports top sits at a weathered wooden table on a sunny sports field and drinks a small glass of orange juice in one go, then lifts the whole glass jug and tips it up over his face, draining it in big greedy gulps, and finally puts it down and breathes out with the empty glasses and the empty jug in front of him.

In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.

A hand pulls a carrot out of dark garden soil and it comes up as long as an arm; next two gardeners heave out a white radish taller than they are, with a mass of roots hanging off it; finally a whole group of gardeners lifts a full-grown tree straight out of the ground in a back garden.

A sushi counter clip. A young chef in a white jacket and a white headband leans over a wooden block and cuts thin flat slices off a long orange fillet of raw fish with a narrow knife. He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.

A young woman in a bright yellow sundress stands in a small clothes boutique in front of a tall wooden-framed mirror and looks at her reflection. She takes a mirror selfie with her phone in front of racks of clothes, then leans towards a vanity mirror ringed with bulbs and checks her face, then spins so the yellow skirt flares out between two mirrors. In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.

A young man in a blue hoodie stands in a hallway and inspects a silver ring through a small jeweller's magnifier, frowning at it. A blonde woman in a grey t-shirt tucks her hair behind her ear in front of a round black-framed bathroom mirror. A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.

At a fashion show, a model with a shaved head and large gold hoop earrings walks straight towards the camera down the runway in a floor-length, loose, shiny green gown with wide draped sleeves. Photographers and seated guests along both sides hold up phones to film her. She comes close enough for the green fabric to fill the frame and looks into the lens, then turns and walks away so the back of the gown swings behind her.

A woman in a bright patchwork shirt and headwrap lowers a huge column of colourful plates into a steel kitchen sink, adding more plates to the top of the stack. Water pours over the tall pile and white foam runs down its sides. She rinses the plates one by one and slots them into the draining rack, and the camera ends on the empty gleaming sink and its drain as she smiles down at it.

A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.

At an autumn pumpkin fair on grass with hay bales and a line of fabric bunting, a middle-sized orange pumpkin drops onto a hay bale in a puff of dust and lands next to a giant pumpkin, while a tiny pumpkin sits on the ground to the left. A young woman with a ponytail, in a rust jumper and denim skirt, shrugs with both palms up and laughs, then bends down towards the pumpkins. A young man in a navy T-shirt walks past behind with a wooden wheelbarrow, and a green cart full of gourds stands under a big oak tree.

On a sunny paved street between tall office buildings, a small car stands with its boot wide open and packed full of colourful balloons in red, blue, green and yellow, with curly ribbons hanging down. A big bunch of balloons floats above the car into the blue sky. A smiling bearded young man in a white vest and linen trousers stands in front of the car, holding the strings, then raises both arms happily, and a yellow balloon drifts down in front of his face.

In a green park in soft evening sunlight, a giant yellow tennis ball, taller than a person, sits on the grass with clumps of earth around it where it has landed. A black and white dog stands beside it, stretches its nose up to sniff the huge ball, walks along it and then turns to look straight ahead. A normal-sized tennis ball lies on the grass in the foreground for comparison. Behind them are a wooden bench, a bin, a gravel path and tall leafy trees.
